name: crochet-peakz
description: Crochet PeakZ — handmade crochet e-commerce platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors cyan,blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@crochet-peakz/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@crochet-peakz/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@crochet-peakz/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@crochet-peakz/api && npm run build --workspace=@crochet-peakz/web
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@crochet-peakz/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
